Name: Animal Cracker Expanded
Author: KhaStark
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS]Animal Cracker Expanded is a standalone SMAPI mod inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40273]Feed More Animal Crackers[/url] by gellingly. This project uses its own mod identity, configuration, unlock system, compatibility handling, and wand asset instead of redistributing the original archive.

The main goal is simple: let Golden Animal Crackers keep scaling animal and fish pond production beyond the first vanilla cracker, while adding a safe way to recover crackers later if you change your mind.

The Animal Cracker Wand was also inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27071]Golden Animal Cracker Extractor[/url] by Selph (zombifier). Animal Cracker Expanded uses its own recovery implementation and wand asset.[/font]

[font=Comic Sans MS][b]Features[/b]
[/font]
[list]

[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Configurable Golden Animal Cracker cap from 2 to 100 total crackers per supported animal or fish pond. Default: 5.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]The first cracker keeps vanilla-style doubling; each additional cracker adds another base-production amount. At the default cap of 5 crackers, production reaches x6.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Supports normal farm animals and compatible custom FarmAnimal types that can already eat Golden Animal Crackers.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Pig / DigUp production support, enabled by default, including truffle-style dug-up produce.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Fish ponds support stacked crackers and display their current cracker count, with separate horizontal and vertical position offsets for Android layouts.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Optional Capybara compatibility for HarrisonGrey's Capybara. This override is OFF by default so the Capybara mod's original no-cracker behavior is preserved unless you explicitly enable it.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Animals-tab cracker display using the format "Crackers: current/max", with configurable horizontal and vertical offsets for Android layouts.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Animal Cracker Wand for recovering crackers from animals and fish ponds.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Wand confirmation prompt before recovery to help prevent accidental mobile taps.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Two refund modes: One at a time or All at once.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Recovered crackers go to your inventory; if the inventory is full, they drop safely on the ground.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Wand unlock is permanent per save after the first successful Golden Animal Cracker feed to a supported animal or fish pond, with Marnie's unlock mail arriving the next morning.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Choose wand acquisition through Marnie's shop, crafting, or both. Default: Both.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Marnie sells the wand when shop acquisition is enabled. Default shop price: 25,000g, configurable from 1,000g to 100,000g.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Crafting recipe: 10 Hardwood + 5 Iridium Bars + 1 Diamond.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Config changes after unlock apply immediately to shop/crafting availability.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Existing saves with a vanilla Golden Animal Cracker already fed to an animal or fish pond are detected and can trigger the unlock flow.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]If the configured maximum is lowered below an animal's stored cracker count, the stored crackers are preserved and remain recoverable; new crackers are rejected until the stored count is below the cap.[/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=Comic Sans MS][b]Requirements[/b]
[/font]
[list]

[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Stardew Valley 1.6.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later according to the manifest.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]

[b]Optional[/b]
[/font]
[list]

[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Generic Mod Config Menu — recommended for changing settings in-game. The mod still works without GMCM.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]HarrisonGrey's Capybara 1.0.2 — only needed if you want to use the optional Capybara cracker override.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b]Tested on[/b]
[/font]
[list]

[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Android[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Stardew Valley 1.6.15.3 build 26177[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]SMAPI Android 4.3.2.5[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Generic Mod Config Menu 1.16.0[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
Desktop is not blocked by the mod, but this release has not been tested or supported on desktop.

[b]Installation[/b]
[/font]
[list=1]

[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Install SMAPI for your platform.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]If Feed More Animal Crackers by gellingly is installed, remove it first. The two mods must not be installed together.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Extract Animal Cracker Expanded into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Optionally install Generic Mod Config Menu if you want to edit settings through an in-game menu.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b]Compatibility / Important notes[/b]
[/font]
[list]

[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Single-player only. Multiplayer is intentionally unsupported. [/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Android is the tested target. Desktop may work, but it is currently untested and unsupported.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Pig support can be disabled without deleting stored cracker data. Stored crackers remain visible/recoverable, but no pig production bonus is applied while the option is off.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Capybara support behaves the same way: disabling the override preserves stored cracker data and allows recovery, but disables the production bonus and prevents new cracker feeding.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b]Credits[/b]
[/font]
[list]

[*][font=Comic Sans MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27071]Golden Animal Cracker Extractor[/url] by Selph (zombifier) — inspiration for the cracker-recovery tool concept. No extractor art assets are included.[/font][/*]
